style: Stylized hand-painted retro arcade 3D game texture, dusk orange-purple palette, flat orthographic (no perspective), no text, no logos, no brand marks (exceto o letreiro da própria loja e o "SHOW 19H").
note: Textura ausente ou com erro cai no desenho procedural em Canvas de mesmo id (index.html). Para regenerar, gere no Higgsfield com o prompt abaixo, salve em assets/_raw/<id>.webp e rode python tools/process_textures.py.

textures.prompt: Seamless tileable top-down dark worn city asphalt, fine gravel grain, subtle cracks and oil stains, no markings.
textures.usage: chão das ruas (repete a cada 8 m)

textures.prompt: Seamless tileable top-down sidewalk of 4x4 square concrete slabs.
textures.usage: calçadas e praças (repete a cada 6 m)

textures.prompt: Flat orthographic 5-storey red brick facade at dusk, lit windows, abstract neon (lightning bolt, guitar), no letters.
Flat orthographic 6-storey teal/cream apartment facade at dusk with balconies and pink neon star/note, no letters.
Flat orthographic 7-storey glass office facade reflecting sunset, green/yellow neon stripe, no letters.

Stylized hand-painted retro arcade 3D game texture, flat orthographic front elevation of a single-storey rock music store facade, based on the storefront reference photo: dark brown sign board with 'Máquina do Mal' in white gothic blackletter, glass windows with guitars, vinyl records and t-shirt silhouettes, central glass door, generic abstract rock graffiti on the side walls (no recognizable characters), dusk orange-purple palette. No people, no other text, no third-party logos.
textures.usage: fachada da loja Máquina do Mal no jogo (recorte 0,40-1344,712 do bruto 16:9). Versão anterior: _raw/store_v1.webp (job 5e77f6e7-a52a-46b3-9fc2-e8fe4aa180e7)
textures.reference: foto da fachada real da loja (pasta sprites/felipe, fora do git) + quadro 1 da HQ

textures.prompt: Wide panoramic dusk sky, orange glow at the bottom to deep indigo at the top, violet clouds, first stars.
Flat orthographic bus side panel, glossy black, purple lower stripe, hot rod flames from the front, 7 tinted windows.
Flat orthographic bus front, big windshield with sunset reflection, round headlights, chrome grille, amber sign "SHOW 19H".
textures.usage: frente do ônibus, quadro 3 da HQ e ícones

textures.prompt: Single stylized tree, round leafy crown, orange sunset rim light, transparent background.

characters.note: Sprites dos personagens: canvas igual para todos, fundo transparente, pés na borda de baixo. Originais em _raw/chars (nomes da pasta sprites). Gere de novo com python tools/process_sprites.py.

comic.note: Quadros da HQ de abertura (1:1). Felipe é personagem estilizado gerado a partir de 2 fotos de referência (fora do git); a mesma geração (p1) serviu de referência para p2, p3 e a fachada, para manter o traço. Textos, cartaz e relógio são HTML por cima. Os quadros p1..p3 ficaram só em _raw/comic (fonte e referência).
comic.style: Classic 1970s-80s Marvel comic book panel, bold black ink outlines, flat vivid colors, Ben-Day dot halftone shading, CMYK print texture, aged newsprint paper grain. No balloons, no captions (os textos ficam no config.js).

panels.prompt: Late afternoon sunset, the Máquina do Mal storefront (from the reference photo, murals replaced by generic rock graffiti); Felipe in the foreground opening the door and checking his watch, surprised.
Inside the store, guitars and records; Felipe on the left 40%, shocked, hands on his head; right side an empty brick wall (cartaz e relógio entram em HTML).
Dusk, the black-and-purple flame tour bus bursting out of the garage, Felipe at the wheel giving a thumbs up; upper left calm for the balloon.

slides.note: Slides atuais (3:2, 840x564) com todo o texto desenhado na arte. Gerados a partir dos quadros p1..p3 (referência).
